ashby:adaptivesecurity:969dae88-342a-438.summary:
Adaptive is a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop AI-powered cyberattacks. In December 2025, the company announced an $81M Series B led by NVIDIA and Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Citi Ventures, and continued support from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the OpenAI Startup Fund, and Abstract Ventures. The round marked NVIDIA’s first AI cybersecurity investment.

Adaptive was founded by Brian Long and Andrew Jones, repeat entrepreneurs who have built and scaled category-defining companies. Brian and Andrew previously co-founded Attentive, which grew to more than $500M in annual revenue and a $10B+ valuation, and TapCommerce, which was acquired by Twitter. Together, they bring deep experience building high-growth, product-led businesses at massive scale as Adaptive builds the security layer for the AI era.

paras: Trusted by leading banks, technology companies, and healthcare organizations, Adaptive protects teams from emerging threats like deepfakes, smishing, and AI-powered voice scams. With rapid enterprise adoption and a $200B+ market ahead, the company is just getting started.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We’re looking for a Senior National Account Manager (NAM) to own Adaptive’s national relationship with CDW, including LiquidPC. You will make CDW one of Adaptive’s largest sources of partner-sourced and partner-transacted revenue.

In this high-impact role, you will act as the strategic lead for one of our most important channel partners, working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Sales Engineering to drive pipeline, enable CDW’s teams, and grow our business together. You will report directly to the SVP of Channel Sales.
This is a remote role, with strong preference for candidates located in Chicago.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the CDW relationship end to end: executive sponsors, partner managers, and sellers across CDW's segments and regions.
Build a joint business plan with CDW, with pipeline and revenue targets, and run quarterly business reviews.
Get Adaptive in front of CDW sellers through CDW's partner programs, floor days and events, and manage the related program spend.
Drive CDW-sourced deal registrations and co-sell with Adaptive's AEs and regional CAMs on CDW-transacted deals.
Train CDW sellers and engineers on Adaptive's Security Awareness Training, Email Security and AI Governance solutions.
Work with Adaptive's legal, finance and deal desk on CDW terms, quoting and SLED buying vehicles through LiquidPC.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 5+ years managing a national reseller relationship, ideally CDW, for a cybersecurity or software vendor.
Established relationships inside CDW, including partner managers and sellers. This matters most.
Experience running pay-to-play programs: seller access, floor days and events.
A track record of growing partner-sourced and partner-transacted revenue.
Comfort with enterprise and public sector buying, including contract vehicles

ashby:airwallex:04f3a2ed-76e2-406e-a58f-.summary:
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told…

paras: You'll lead product marketing for the products developers use to build on Airwallex: APIs, the sandbox, documentation, and AgentOS, including its MCP servers, CLI, and skills. You'll shape positioning and launch plans for developers, technical founders, builders using AI coding tools, and technology partners integrating with Airwallex.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining positioning, launches, technical product use, and developer research. You'll test the products yourself, track how developers move from learning about Airwallex to making a first API call and reaching production, and use those insights to improve messaging, documentation, and product adoption.

You'll work with Product, DevX, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Legal, Brand, Marketing, Communications, and technical writers. You'll own the message and launch plans, while partnering with technical writers and product teams who own integrations, documentation, and case studies.

sections.title: Essentials
bullets: 7+ years of experience in product marketing, developer marketing, or a similar role, including positioning and launching APIs, developer tools, agentic systems, or other technical products.
Hands-on technical ability: you can read API documentation, make API calls, and build a small working prototype, including with AI coding tools.
Strong writing skills, with examples of positioning documents, launch posts, or landing pages written for developers.
Experience owning launches from the brief through to results, including setting goals using usage data such as sign-ups, activation, and conversion.
Experience working with Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, and Marketing.
Comfort setting direction while products are changing quickly and processes are still being established, and getting to outcomes in a lean environment.

sections.title: Preferred
bullets: Experience marketing payments, fintech infrastructure, or other regulated financial products, and working with Legal or Compliance on product claims.
Experience with AI agents, MCP, agent frameworks, or AI coding tools, either in a product you marketed or through your own work.
A developer launch where you can name the usage metric that moved and by how much.
Experience working with technical writers on documentation landing pages, getting-started paths, or search optimisation.
Experience with startups and technical founders, including accelerator programmes, developer communities, or hackathons.

sections.title: You'll thrive here if
bullets: You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.
You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.
You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.
You stay close to your industry, follow trends, and bring outside perspective into your work.

ashby:aurorasolar:253fa4a8-4767-405e-8a5.summary:
Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale.

paras: The Product Marketing team at Aurora Solar crafts powerful positioning, messaging, and enablement to drive customer acquisition, retention, and expansion. We are the voice of the customer internally and the voice of the product externally. From product strategy to launch, our primary focus is to ensure that our solutions are positioned optimally in the market.

paras: As our next Product Marketing Manager, you will be the go-to expert on key parts of our residential solar sales and design solutions and a confident generalist across the rest. You will develop a deep understanding of our buyers, our product, and the market. That means staying ahead of the industry trends shaping how installers sell and design, from policy and incentive changes to shifts in financing, storage adoption, and homeowner expectations. You’ll also keep a close eye on the competitive landscape, competitor developments and continuously refine our key differentiators.

You’ll use that knowledge to shape the strategies and tactics that deliver the most value to customers. You will guide go-to-market strategy and activities for new features, sharpen the product narrative against alternatives, and create compelling content for internal and external activations. This is a highly collaborative role with meaningful impact at the intersection of Marketing, Product, Sales, and Account Management while being a trusted voice on where we stand in the market and why we win.

sections.title: Your Impact
bullets: Become a subject-matter expert on key parts of Aurora’s sales and design solutions, informing go-to-market strategy, roadmap, and campaigns to drive growth
Stay ahead of industry trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to ensure our solutions remain differentiated and relevant
Monitor the competitive landscape and competitor moves, continually refining our key differentiators and how we position against alternatives
Create positioning, messaging, and product narratives that speak to customer needs at each stage of the buyer journey

Build and amplify compelling content for key enablement assets such as customer-facing presentations, buyer’s guides, battlecards, product collateral, solution guides, return on investment models, customer testimonials, etc.

Manage product launch campaigns by formulating and implementing the go-to-market strategy for new product segments and features, collaborating with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Enablement) to establish messaging, positioning, pricing, demos, and packaging

Measure and analyze the success of marketing campaigns, launches, product adoption, and messaging by analyzing important data, capturing feedback, and making data-driven recommendations for improvement
Partner with Marketing to drive pipeline through marketing campaigns, thought influence, content marketing, webinars, events, and more

bullets: 5+ years of combined experience in product marketing, marketing, product management, or the residential solar industry (sales, design, or operations), with exposure to B2B software go-to-market

Understanding of how to bring new products or features to market, or direct experience doing so, across multiple audiences, such as decision-makers and day-to-day users, or businesses of different sizes
A strong instinct for what’s happening in the market and why it matters, plus an interest in turning trends and competitor moves into clear differentiation
A strategic, structured problem solver who uses quantitative and qualitative data to shape new ideas and initiatives that drive business growth
Ability to build strong relationships with cross-functional teams and customers, and enjoys being the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Marketing, and Account Management
An excellent storyteller, writer, and presenter who can turn industry and product complexity into clear, engaging positioning and narratives
Resourceful and adaptable in a fast-paced environment
Highly organized and self-directed

paras: The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.
Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process.

We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. ashby:ignite-reading:aef263df-4820-44ba-.summary:
Today, 67% of students and 82% of low-income students can’t read at grade level by the end of third grade. That’s when students are supposed to go from learning to read to reading to learn. It’s America’s number one education crisis and we know how to fix it.

Ignite Reading delivers one-to-one virtual tutoring that teaches every student the foundational skills they need to become a confident, fluent reader. We pair students who need extra support with expert reading tutors who provide daily, 15-minute, Science of Reading-based instruction that rapidly closes their decoding gaps. We focus on the foundational reading skills—phonics, phonemic awareness, and sight words—kids need to master so they can decode a sentence. Students in Ignite Reading’s program achieve over 2 weeks of reading skills growth per week of instruction, and notably all students achieve the same outstanding results…

You have a strong instinct for what makes an experience intuitive, ensuring customers can focus on accomplishing their goals rather than figuring out how to use the product.

You'll own product priorities within your area, balancing user needs, business objectives, and technical considerations. You'll work directly with your design and engineering partners to turn ideas into products, from early exploration and prototyping through development and launch.

You'll help shape these systems to support Ignite Reading's continued growth.

Reporting: Tools that help our school partners understand student participation and progress.
Tutor Operations: Systems that support tutor training and payroll.

Insurance billing is one of the hardest and least loved jobs in running a clinic, especially for our US practices, and taking that weight off their plates is one of the most meaningful ways we get to help the helpers.

Hands-on, thoughtful use of AI in your day-to-day product work, plus curiosity about using it to contribute more directly, like shipping small changes to the codebase.

Define positioning and messaging by product and state, partnering with product owners, UX research, marketing, and sales to find the stories that convert

Identify and size priority audience segments, such as first-time homebuyers or Spanish-speaking homeowners in growth markets, and define the data, routing, and experience each segment needs to be activated

bullets: Several integrated campaigns have launched against defined audiences, with measurable lifts in lead conversion and lead-to-customer conversion traced back to them
Clear, tested positioning exists for our core products and priority states, and channel teams are using it in their own work

ashby:pylon:7fcba195-a756-4674-ad35-3d6a.summary:
America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.
Join us in building America’s mortgage rails .

sections.title: About the role
paras: Agents are starting to do a lot of the work in mortgage, both at Pylon and at our customers. We’re hiring a Lead PM to own the Agent Platform, which is what every Pylon agent is built on and how outside agents work with Pylon.

The job has two halves. The first is internal. You’ll build the tools and infrastructure our engineers, operators, and business teams use to build, test, ship, and monitor agents, for everything from reading documents to underwriting to closing.

The second is external. Our customers are building their own agents, and you’ll make Pylon the easiest place for those agents to do real work. That means MCP servers, APIs designed with agents in mind, and the permissions and guardrails that keep it all safe.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Set the direction for agents across Pylon and get product, engineering, and operations aligned on where they’ll make the biggest difference
Own the roadmap for the platform’s core pieces, like tools, orchestration, context and memory, retrieval, evals, observability, and guardrails
Make it much faster for internal teams to go from an idea to an agent running in production, and give them shared patterns so nobody builds the same thing twice
Treat evals as a product of their own. Teams should have shared datasets, benchmarks, and regression checks, plus human review wherever a regulated decision needs it
Own how external agents work with Pylon, including MCP servers, APIs, scoped permissions, rate limits, and docs that both people and LLMs can follow
Make sure we can trace and explain every action an agent takes. We’d rather design for regulators from the start than bolt it on later
Make build or buy calls on models, vector databases, frameworks, and vendors, and keep an eye on cost, latency, and quality
Write and ship code yourself. You’ll commit to our codebase, build agents on the platform, and understand it the way its users do, which keeps the team close to what’s actually possible

sections.title: About you
bullets: You have strong opinions and you’ll defend them. We argue about decisions a lot here, and we’ll ask you to explain your thinking and stand behind it. We also expect you to change your mind when someone shows you you’re wrong.

You’re ruthless about priorities. Our full stack approach means there’s always more to do than people to do it, so you keep the team on the highest-ROI work and you’re comfortable saying no to good ideas that come at the wrong time.

You’re comfortable in a heavily regulated market. Compliance is non-negotiable for us. We work with regulators to push the industry forward and get better outcomes for borrowers. We play by the rules, and we play to win.
You care a lot about our customers and their borrowers, and you hold a high bar for them. We’ll do whatever it takes to make them successful on Pylon.

You default to software over manual work. One of our guiding principles is that anything in the backend mortgage process done by a human is a bug. We can’t automate everything right away, so when we need a temporary workaround, you flag it, write it down, and push for the real fix.

You’re good with people. You’ll work with internal teams who want different things, engineers on the customer side, and a long list of model and tooling vendors, and you know how to build real relationships and get results through them.
You have a lot of ideas. You notice things that could be better about the product and the team, and we’ll give you room to act on them.
You’re willing to get into the weeds. You can learn mortgage well enough to sound like a 20-year veteran, and you keep up with AI research like someone who actually builds with it.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: Snowflake’s product experience is how customers engage with our data and AI platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Horizontal UI Experiences, you will improve the quality, speed, consistency, and reach of Snowflake’s UI experience across the workflows and shared UI capabilities customers rely on every day.

You will own a focused, cross-product charter spanning core customer journeys, UI platform components, design systems, performance, accessibility, and global readiness. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, and product teams to turn customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable improvements.

sections.title: AS A SENIOR PM AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:
bullets: Own the product strategy and roadmap for horizontal UI experiences, balancing customer needs, product quality, technical constraints, and business impact.
Improve end-to-end experiences across login and authentication, the homepage, and core customer journeys.
Partner with design and engineering to evolve shared UI capabilities, including the design system and personalization, so experiences feel coherent across products.
Drive improvements to performance and product latency, working with engineering teams to identify the highest-impact opportunities and measure progress.
Make Snowflake work for more customers by advancing accessibility, localization, URL readiness, and support for additional regions.
Build a strong understanding of customer friction through research, usage data, customer feedback, and cross-functional input.
Define success measures, establish baselines, and use evidence to prioritize work and assess whether changes improve customer experience.
Create alignment across partner product teams and functions, making ownership, trade-offs, and decisions clear.

sections.title: OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:
bullets: 4+ years of product management experience owning and delivering customer-facing software products or substantial product areas.
A track record of turning customer problems into a focused product strategy, roadmap, and shipped outcomes.
Strong product judgment for end-to-end workflows, usability, and consistent experiences across multiple surfaces.
Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
The ability to partner effectively with engineering and design on technically complex product areas, and to communicate trade-offs clearly.
Experience influencing multiple teams and stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain decisions and bring teams along.

Shared UI platforms, design systems, or horizontal product experiences.
Product work involving performance and latency, authentication, accessibility, localization, or regional availability.

ashby:socure:10afe7ac-fe43-4a1c-afd5-2a0.summary:
Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

sections.title: About the role
paras: You'll be the technical voice in the room when Socure sells our orchestration platform to banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and more, owning every technical conversation from first discovery through signed contract, and building the decisioning workflow that ships with the deal.

sections.title: What you’ll do
paras: You'll run point on 50+ active deals at any given time, partnered with an Account Executive. On a given week you are:
bullets: Leading a discovery call with a Fortune 100 bank's fraud ops team, then translating what you heard into a solution design their architects will actually implement

Negotiating integration architecture - REST vs. SDK, sync vs. async, endpoint-only vs. full orchestration with a technical buyer who has opinions and constraints (security reviews, model risk governance, carrier consent, latency SLAs)
Co-authoring the mutual action plan with your AE, identifying the real blockers, and getting unstuck when a security review or legal redline threatens the close date
Demoing our no-code decisioning platform to an audience that ranges from a VP of Fraud to a staff engineer and calibrating the story to both
Escalating real customer requirements into Product and Engineering, and pushing back on a prospect when what they're asking for isn't right for them

sections.title: What makes this role different from most SC jobs
paras: Most pre-sales SC roles stop at the solution design. This one doesn't.

Almost all of the build happens in pre-sales. You're not just scoping the solution, you're configuring it inside the RiskOS Platform, our no-code decisioning platform. You'll orchestrate identity, fraud, and device signals across Socure's product suite into a live workflow: setting thresholds, wiring reason codes into branching logic, defining fallbacks and step-ups, and shipping a decisioning flow the customer can actually put into production.

That means when a deal closes, the decision logic is already built. Your job then shifts to a clean handoff with the Post-Sales and Technical Project Management teams. Partnering tightly to get the customer live fast, cleanly, and without losing the context you built during the sales cycle. Our best deals close and integrate without a handoff gap, and that's because the Platform SC owns the technical narrative end-to-end and hands it off as a working system, not a slide deck.

sections.title: What we're optimizing for
paras: We hire for four things, roughly in this order:
bullets: Grit and broad shoulders. Deals break. Timelines slip. A prospect's config blows up your sandbox plan the day before a demo. The best SCs on this team absorb chaos, keep momentum, and don't need to be rescued.

Sales acumen. You understand that your job is to help your AE close revenue, not to be the smartest person in the room. You can read a deal, spot a stalled champion, objection handle, and know when to push vs. when to back off.
Fraud, risk, or identity experience. Nice to have, not required. We'll teach you the domain if the other three are strong.

ashby:uniti:008eda1d-b382-423e-9791-d1ab.summary:
Real estate is the world's largest asset class — $393 trillion globally, bigger than all stocks, bonds, and gold combined. Over $1 trillion a year, globally, goes to the teams running properties — leasing, maintenance, collections, accounting, marketing, HR, asset management. Same bundle of tasks at every property, every day, across every vertical. The surface looks different across office, multifamily, senior living, self-storage, affordable housing, student housing, coworking, hospitality. The work underneath is the same.

Today that work is stuck in tickets, phone queues, and a dozen disconnected tools. Real estate has been waiting for an execution layer.

sections.title: Why Uniti
paras: Uniti is building it — the system of action for real estate. AI agents for every front- and back-office workflow, operating across voice, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat. One horizontal layer, every vertical. Work gets done faster, around the clock. The humans on our customers' teams get to focus on the parts of the job that actually need them.

sections.title: About the role
paras: As a Customer Success Manager at Uniti, you'll own customer relationships from the moment they go live through renewal and expansion, across every vertical we serve. You'll partner with Sales, Implementation, Product, and Engineering to make every operator successful with their first agent — and walk them into the next one. This role exists because our customer book is growing faster than any one person can hold, and because the customers we keep and grow this year are the ones who carry us into the next vertical.

sections.title: What you'll own
bullets: Own the post-sale relationship for every operator on your book — onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion.
Partner with the AE on a clean Sales-to-Implementation handoff, then run the kickoff and pilot phase alongside the Implementation Manager through go-live.
Monitor agent performance and operator health weekly — call quality, response time, conversion, escalations — and surface risks before they become churn.
Lead renewal conversations and identify expansion paths into additional agent families and additional channels. You own the commercial conversation, not just the relationship.
Translate what you hear from operators into product feedback that lands with the right people on Product and Engineering. Be the operator's voice in the building.
Keep internal systems current — health scores, churn risk indicators, expansion forecasts, check-in cadence in Monday.com — so commercial leadership can see the book at a glance.
Develop real affinity for what our customers actually deal with day-to-day. Talk to operators. Sit in on calls. Share what you learn with the team.

sections.title: What you have
bullets: 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Partnerships at a SaaS or AI company.
Real estate or multi-location operator experience strongly preferred. Time spent operating, selling into, or supporting real estate operators is the single best predictor of success in this role.
Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle from pilot through renewal and expansion. You've owned commercial conversations before, not just relationship ones.
CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), a BI tool, Monday.com or similar.
Analytical instinct: you can read an operator's adoption metrics and tell us what's actually going on, not just what the dashboard says.
A track record of running ambiguous customer situations end-to-end — figuring out what's broken, scoping the fix, and bringing in the right internal partners.

More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.

We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.

sections.title: About the Position
paras: As an Onboarding and Implementation Manager at Vetcove, you'll lead the strategy and execution of end-to-end onboarding for veterinary clinics across our platform. You'll manage and mentor a team of 5+ Onboarding Specialists, setting the standard for how clinics experience implementation—from kickoff through post-launch—while ensuring every clinic is positioned for long-term success.

You'll serve as the point of contact for clinic partnerships during implementation, drive cross-functional alignment with product, engineering, strategy, and support, and build the systems and processes that allow your team to scale. In some cases, you may travel to client sites to support critical go-lives and ensure successful deployment.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5+ Onboarding Specialists, driving accountability and a high standard of client delivery
Own the overall implementation strategy and lifecycle—from project planning frameworks to go-live execution
Serve as the escalation point and key liaison between veterinary clinics and internal teams, ensuring a seamless and consultative onboarding experience
Define team-wide project goals, success metrics, and delivery standards aligned with client needs and business priorities
Guide clinics through complex migrations of existing workflows onto a new platform, providing both strategic direction and hands-on support where needed
Build, refine, and scale project management processes, templates, and tooling used across the team
Oversee training delivery and support your team in troubleshooting configuration, data imports, and integrations
Maintain clear, executive-level communication with internal stakeholders and client leadership to ensure transparency and alignment

sections.title: You Should Have

Proven experience leading and developing high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders
Proficiency in project management tools and experience building scalable processes, timelines, and reporting frameworks
Experience working with clinics, healthcare providers, or other medical environments is a plus but not required
Willingness to travel to client sites as needed (up to 10–15%)

ashby:whippy:8b0ae666-af47-49cf-a080-d4e.summary:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an entrepreneurial Customer Success Manager to retain and grow a dedicated book of customers.

This role is for someone with 2-5 years of experience who's ready to own a book of customers end to end.

sections.title: Why I'm hiring
paras: At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

sections.title: Some things you'll do
bullets: Own a book of business end to end , from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as the single point of contact and trusted advisor.
Run a proactive cadence on every account : prepared calls, clear agendas, mutual success plans, and follow-through.
Become a product and customer expert. Master Whippy's products and know your customers' business well enough to build the workflows, AI agents, and automations that solve their problems.
Juggle multiple customers and projects at once , and prioritize based on impact.
Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.
Own your gross and net revenue retention , and get rewarded for beating targets.
Tie usage to business outcomes , and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.
Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

sections.title: Our customer success values
paras: This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:
bullets: Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.
We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.
We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.
CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.
Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.
Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.
Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.
Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.
Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.
Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

2-5 years in a customer-facing role (customer success, account management) at a technical SaaS product. If your path is unconventional and you can explain how it'll help you succeed in this role, I welcome you to apply.

sections.title: Why I'm hiring
paras: At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

bullets: Design and build solutions in Whippy without engineering : workflows, AI voice and text agents, automations, and data syncs back into the customer's ATS.
Scope technical requirements with customers , translate them into a working build, and test and verify every piece before it goes live.
Own the customer after go-live , from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as their single point of contact and trusted technical advisor.
Juggle multiple customers and projects at once , and prioritize based on impact.
Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.
Own your gross and net revenue retention , and get rewarded for beating targets.
Tie usage to business outcomes , and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.
Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

sections.title: Our customer success values
paras: This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:
bullets: Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.
We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.
We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.
CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.
Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.
Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.

Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

sections.title: Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
paras: Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
bullets: No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Please always verify communications:


• Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

greenhouse:attentive:4507440009.summary:
Attentive’s autonomous marketing system is only as smart as the context it can reach. Every system a brand uses (its commerce platform, loyalty program, ticketing system, or point-of-sale) holds signals that help our agents decide what to say, to whom, and when. Integrations provide the data and context that is the fuel for Attentive’s Agent OS.

Today, Attentive builds and maintains most of its integrations ourselves. That model doesn’t scale to the long tail of systems our brands rely on. We’ve rebuilt our integrations platform from the ground up so that any human or agent team can ship integration features in a single day. The first version of this platform will let our internal product teams ship hundreds of integration features in a single quarter.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the Lead Product Manager, Agentic Integrations Platform, you will turn that foundation into an ecosystem. You’ll expand the platform beyond its product team to two new builder personas: Attentive’s customer-facing teams along with external technology partners who want to build on Attentive. Alongside them, AI agents are a first-class builder persona, and you’ll design for humans and agents working together.
This role requires a deep understanding of user personas and what technical integration use cases they are trying to unlock and how to leverage AI to improve the process and experience.
This hybrid role is based in our New York office, with in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday each week.

sections.title: What You’ll Accomplish
bullets: Take ownership of the AI-native integrations platform and evolve it from its initial concepts into a platform that internal customer-facing teams, external partners, client IT teams and AI agents can use to build and ship integrations themselves

Define the framework for which integrations Attentive builds and owns versus those we enable other builders to deliver, and hold a clear, opinionated point of view on when it’s in our best interest to own the build.

Own the quality floor for integrations built on the platform. When platform limitations hold back integration quality, you’ll identify those pain points and prioritize the platform improvements that raise the floor.

Treat Attentive’s integration PMs as your first customers: understand their needs, translate them into platform capabilities, and make them dramatically more productive as they launch and manage a growing portfolio of integrations.
Grow the number of supported integrations so that Attentive Agent OS can connect to any system that holds useful context.

sections.title: Your Expertise
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience, including building platform, integration, or builder-facing products in B2B SaaS.

Working technical fluency in how two systems connect (APIs, webhooks, data syncs, authentication, and error handling) and a clear understanding of how product and engineering teams have historically worked together to deliver integrations that connect systems seamlessly.
A strong point of view on how AI agents are changing the way integrations get built. You can tell where agents deliver the first 90% and where the remaining details still need review from a human.
Experience building for platform users, such as developer platforms, partner ecosystems, app marketplaces, or no-code builders. You enjoy making other builders successful.
Comfort serving internal product teams as customers, and the judgment to balance their specific requests against the long-term health of the platform.
Exceptional written communication and structured thinking. Much of this role is defining strategy from a blank page and aligning product, engineering, revenue teams, and partners around it.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of…

sections.title: The Role
paras: As we grow Square's presence across the US Retail Channel, we're looking for a Retail Partner Manager to drive awareness and acquisition of Square at major US retailers such as Best Buy, Walmart, Target, and other large format retailers. You'll own quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware in the channel – optimizing our existing retail partnerships and unlocking new growth within them, from partner mix, placement, and promotional strategy to entirely new ways of partnering. This is a high-ownership role that requires an entrepreneurial operator: someone who navigates ambiguity and setbacks with resourcefulness, engages the right internal partners – across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Finance.

sections.title: You will:
bullets: Own channel results: Meet quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware across US retail, tracking sell-through, forecasting, and growth initiatives tied to seller acquisition and revenue.
Build the playbook: Create, test, and evolve go-to-market strategies for key retailers – including approaches that don't exist yet today – moving fast from hypothesis to pilot to scaled rollout.

Grow existing partnerships: Own relationships with current retailers and distributor partners end-to-end as their primary contact at Square, proactively architecting new partnership models and formats rather than defending the status quo.

Source and sign new partners: Identify, evaluate, pitch, negotiate, and close new retail partnerships from the ground up – often with no existing relationship, internal champion, or playbook to follow.

Drive cross-functional execution: Lead work across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Finance, Product Marketing, and Operations on launches, weekly forecasting, and GTM readiness – proactively pulling in the right people for thought partnership when you hit a wall, rather than waiting to be told.

Deploy budget like an owner: Manage the retail marketing budget with a test-and-learn mindset – run scrappy experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate investment with urgency toward what's working.

sections.title: You Have:
bullets: 5+ years in business-to-business sales, account management, or retail marketing – preferably in Consumer Electronics, with deep experience at Best Buy, Walmart, Costco, or other large-format retailers.
A proven track record of building a partnership, program, or channel from scratch and scaling it to success – without relying on existing playbooks or infrastructure.
Resourcefulness and tenacity to push through obstacles and find creative paths to results in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

The ability to balance quarterly execution with a multi-quarter strategic view – and to see around the corner as the retail landscape evolves.
Strong analytical, structured thinking to assess business opportunities and campaign performance, balanced with comfort acting before all the data or process exists.
Experience managing external decision makers and influencing cross-functional teams through credibility rather than authority.

paras: Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. bullets: Are a builder. Your best work has come from creating systems, programs, or partnerships from the ground up – not from optimizing something already running.

Are energized by dead ends. You don't have every answer up front, and the process of finding them invigorates you. When a path gets blocked, your instinct is to find three more, not to escalate and wait.
Test and learn with urgency. You'd rather run a scrappy pilot this week and learn from it than wait for a perfect plan next quarter – and you move fast once you see a signal.

Operate like an owner. You hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not activity, and you don't need supervision or structure to do your best work. Ambiguity is part of the gig, and you like it that way.

Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

sections.title: ABOUT VEG
paras: This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.
VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

sections.title: THE JOB
paras: As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

sections.title: WHAT YOU’LL DO
bullets: Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs
Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.
Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

sections.title: WHAT YOU NEED
bullets: 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software
Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos
High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

sections.title: Position Overview:
paras: We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to run execution on Zynga's internal AI operating platform - the system through which teams across the company access, govern, and act on AI capabilities. This role owns the operational backbone that turns AI requests into shipped capabilities: intake, triage, research, execution with engineering, and measurement of impact.

You'll partner directly with engineering to drive delivery across a platform spanning several interconnected surfaces (chat, knowledge bases, connectors/MCPs, workflows, and documents). This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone who's energized by running a tight operational loop - turning incoming requests into scoped work, keeping engineering unblocked, and holding the team accountable to outcomes with data. You'll work within a roadmap and priorities set by product leadership, and focus on making sure the right things get built, on time, and that you can prove they're working.

sections.title: What You'll Do:
bullets: Drive day-to-day execution of the AI platform roadmap in close partnership with engineering - from spec through release and post-launch iteration.

Build and run the intake and triage process for incoming requests (studio needs, feature ideas, bugs, integration asks), establishing clear criteria for prioritization and a repeatable operating cadence.

Conduct research to support product decisions - technical landscape scans (models, tooling, competitive AI platforms), stakeholder discovery, and feasibility assessments - and turn findings into clear, actionable write-ups.
Own the measurement framework for the platform: usage, adoption, and performance metrics, reporting cadence, and the mechanisms to catch regressions or gaps early.
Write clear, detailed, and technically grounded specs and requirements for complex, cross-surface features; make day-to-day tradeoff calls when priorities, timelines, or scope conflict.
Act as the primary product point of contact for engineering on your area, unblocking the team and escalating the right issues to leadership.
Coordinate with design, other product leads, and studio stakeholders to keep execution aligned with agreed priorities.
Stay current on the technical AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, emerging tools) as it relates to features already in flight or under evaluation.

sections.title: What You Bring:
bullets: 6+ years of end-to-end PM experience, leading complex, technical, multi-team product areas from strategy through delivery.
Deep technical fluency & engineering partnership: Able to navigate specs, APIs, and system constraints to make credible tradeoffs and earn team trust.
AI/ML expertise: Hands-on experience with AI-powered products (LLMs, agents, RAG, automation) and using AI tools to streamline internal workflows.
Strong operational rigor: Track record of designing structured intake/triage processes, managing competing priorities, and driving multi-workstream execution.
Data-driven decision making: Proficient in defining metrics, analyzing data (SQL/dashboards), and using evidence to prioritize and measure impact.
Exceptional communication: Proven ability to write clear specs and translate complex technical execution for both engineering and senior leadership.
High agency in ambiguity: A self-starter who thrives in undefined environments, takes ownership, and shapes process rather than waiting for direction.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree a plus). Agile-fluent.

lever:getmaple:7e18a30b-a990-4029-ad3f-9.summary:
Maple's purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We're Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we're proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what's possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you'll do work that changes lives—including your own.

sections.title: The role
paras: As we scale our Channel Partnerships business—one of Maple's largest commercial revenue drivers, partnering with insurance providers, benefit brokers, and reseller partnerships—we are hiring a Key Account Manager to lead the long-term success of our highest-value, most complex relationships.

In this role, you will develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans for a concentrated portfolio of key partners. You’ll lead executive-level QBRs, drive retention and expansion strategy, and build the operational framework needed to protect and grow our most strategic commercial relationships.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
bullets: Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of Maple's highest-value, most complex accounts, building relationships at the director, VP and C-suite levels.
Develop and own formal account plans—multi-year vision, joint success metrics, risk and mitigation plans, and growth roadmaps—for every account in your portfolio.
Lead Executive Business Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews with senior stakeholders to communicate ROI, align on strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship.
Stay close to each client's broader business strategy, market pressures and internal shifts, and proactively adjust Maple's approach to anticipate their needs.

Own renewal strategy end-to-end, from early risk detection and stakeholder mapping to competitive positioning and negotiation, and keep forecasting sharp to support revenue planning and leadership reporting.

Proactively identify and shape expansion opportunities—new products, populations, geographies and deeper integration—positioning Maple's solutions to solve strategic client problems, while building the systems that help you get ahead of risk before it turns into churn.
Translate complex account data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior stakeholders, and advocate internally to influence roadmap and operational priorities.
Lead cross-functional account teams—spanning Product, Clinical Operations and Marketing—to keep every team aligned around one cohesive account strategy.

sections.title: What success looks like
paras: In your first 90 days, you'll build relationships with the primary stakeholders across your key account portfolio—at the director, VP and C-suite level—while getting to know Maple's business model and the Channel Partnerships portfolio inside and out. You'll draft initial account plans for each of your accounts, including early identification of risks and opportunities.

Over your first 12–18 months, you'll independently own multi-year account plans and lead executive business reviews across your full portfolio. You'll show measurable contribution to your portfolio's net revenue retention and expansion targets, stand up systems that catch risk before it becomes an escalation, and contribute playbooks that raise the bar for account management across the wider Client Success team.

sections.title: What you bring
paras: Play to your strengths. Finding the right fit goes both ways—so this section is yours to complete. When you join, you'll add the unique strengths you bring that aren't captured above.
bullets: 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, Account Management or a related client-facing role, including 3+ years owning enterprise or key accounts in SaaS, health tech, benefits or an adjacent industry.
A proven track record driving renewals and expansion, and hitting or exceeding portfolio-level net revenue retention or growth targets.
Experience leading executive-level engagements, including Quarterly and Executive Business Reviews, roadmap presentations and contract negotiations.
A demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic account plans while coordinating cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical skills, with comfort working across performance, financial and operational data.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the range to adapt from operational stakeholders to C-suite executives.
A systems-thinking mindset—you can connect client strategy, member populations, internal operations and product capabilities to spot risks and opportunities across your portfolio.

An ownership mentality at scale—you make disciplined trade-offs between client outcomes and Maple's strategic priorities, and build the documentation and succession practices that keep your accounts resilient to change.

lever:houzz:d921a242-446b-4752-a7b7-61fb.summary:
Houzz Pro is all-in-one business software for builders, remodelers and interior designers. It covers everything from winning the job to getting paid. Our Product Marketing team is organized around how pros actually run a project, not around product features. We don't sell estimates or invoices. We sell a better way to run a job.

We're looking for a Senior PMM who knows the construction industry firsthand. You'll own the go-to-market story for how builders and remodelers move from an approved estimate to getting paid, and how they keep their clients informed along the way. You'll work closely with Product and Engineering teams in the US, Taiwan, and Tel Aviv, and you'll be the voice of the builder in those rooms.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Position and message by workflow. Turn features into stories that sound like a builder talking. Show where each capability fits in the job, what comes before and after it, and why it matters to the business.
Launch new products, including AI. Run GTM from tiering through launch to adoption. AI is a top launch theme going into 2027, and you'll carry it across your workflows.
Bring the market into the roadmap. Run customer interviews, mine sales calls, and turn what you learn into clear input for Product: pain points, use cases and competitive gaps.

Enable Sales and Customer Success. Build talk tracks, demos and training so reps and account managers understand how a builder's business works, including fixed price vs. cost plus and why cost codes matter.
Create content that teaches. Plan tutorials, webinars and landing pages. Partner with our lifecycle marketers, who own the email and in-app journeys that deliver your message.
Show up in the industry. Help shape our presence at industry events, including demos, panels and customer stories.
Measure what matters. Set success metrics for every launch and report on adoption and impact.

bullets: 6+ years in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.

Hands-on experience in the construction or home-services industry is required. You've worked in or alongside a building, remodeling or trades business, or you've spent real time selling and marketing to one.
You understand how a construction business makes money: fixed-price vs. cost-plus contracts, cost codes, change orders, progress invoicing, and where margin is won or lost.
A track record of launches with measurable adoption, not just shipped assets.
Strong writing and presenting. You're comfortable on a webinar, in front of a sales team, or across the table from a VP.
You work well with distributed teams and can regularly overlap with European colleagues during Eastern-time mornings.

sections.title: Ideally, You'll Also Have
bullets: Experience marketing to construction, field-service or other vertical industries.
Payments or fintech product marketing experience (embedded payments, accounts receivable, transaction adoption).
Experience launching AI-powered products.
Comfort on camera for tutorials and video content.

smartrecruiters:renesaselectronics:74400.summary: The Enterprise Strategic Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth, retention, and expansion across a defined set of named enterprise accounts. This role owns the end-to-end sales lifecycle—from executive-level discovery through contract negotiation, onboarding alignment, renewal, and expansion. Success in this role is measured by quota attainment, forecast accuracy, customer retention, and pipeline health.

paras:

smartrecruiters:renesaselectronics:74400.summary: The Senior Implementation Engineer (SIE) is assigned to customers once the deal is closed. SIEs ensure that customers understand and experience the value of Altium’s Enterprise solutions (AES). The SIE enables the customer’s successful implementation of AES, and ensures they are productive. The effectiveness in influencing both internal and external stakeholders is the single most important characteristic of the SIE. SIEs demonstrate value, can put systems and processes into common practice, and efficiently resolve internal and external issues. The SIE plays an indispensable role in bridging the gap between the Altium Sales, Customer Success (Technical Support) and R&D organizations.

sections.title: Key Competencies
bullets: Ability to think strategically and understand Altium’s goals and objectives, and influence decisions and policies that will help Altium AND the customer achieve goals and objectives.
Possess emotional intelligence to empathize with the customer, understand who the customer is, how they think, and translate that into customer requirements.
Be action-oriented and leverage project management skills to work effectively with deployment and technical support teams.
Proactively drive improvements to systems, processes, products, and solutions.
Be proactive in identifying critical client deadlines while demonstrating the ability to independently organize, oversee, and fulfill project timelines to ensure consistent delivery.

sections.title: Job Description
bullets: Work with Account Managers, Solution Architects and other SIEs on training, guiding, and coaching customers through the myAltium engagement process.
Provide detailed Project management skills for the Implementation and ensure the customer’s ongoing success post deployment.
Use in-depth knowledge of client, industry, business processes, and deep knowledge of the product and technical expertise to drive and increase adoption and usage of AES.
Serve as the post-sale point of contact for customers during AES implementation..
Collaborate with Altium’s Customer Success (Technical Support) and R&D organizations to ensure timely resolution of issues, and to propose solutions that continually add value to the customer.
Handle escalations of implementation and customer productivity blocking issues, and coordinate related activities with Sales, TAMs, R&D, and Customer Success (Tech Support).
Work with Solution Architects and R&D to resolve software issues that have the highest impact to the customer and Altium’s business.
Build excellent customer relationships, and influence them to adopt recommended best practices.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Bachelors/Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent degree and experience
At least 5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role in Electronic Design Automation (EDA)
Experience with Altium or other PCB ECAD Library/component management required
PLM expertise desirable
Ability to engage customer at business level, drive alignment, and execution
Ability to be highly effective in a matrix management organization
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Able to travel 30%

sections.title: Additional Information
